component.name: Preview
component.summary: View and export images and PDF documents

description.p: Preview is a fast image and PDF viewer for the Linux desktop, built with GTK4 and libadwaita. It opens the formats your system has loaders for, including PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, JPEG XL, TIFF and SVG, alongside multi-page PDF documents.

ul.li: Tabs, so several documents stay open at once
Thumbnail sidebar with lazy rendering for long documents
Zoom to fit, fill or actual size, and zoom at the pointer
Rectangular selection, cropping and export between formats
Fullscreen viewing and a timed slideshow
Printing through the standard GTK print dialog
